text: Entry 1910 replaces the old disposition-first binary classification. Current getAttachmentName rejects multipart containers and unmarked text but returns a filename, including an empty one, for other types. The decoded getFull representation attaches body only for non-attachment text; rawBody remains available through the separate raw-content branch; listInlineTextParts applies the same exclusion. The PDF fixture is inline, not attachment disposition, and its test expects one attachment named Simple_file.pdf at part 1.2. The task skips IMAP, so it is not proof of IMAP behavior. This is static source inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Inline binary MIME parts are attachments while plain body text stays separate
